about: My work sits where public policy meets technology. I make sure that national digital systems are not only built, but governed well: clear institutional ownership, sound architecture, secure operations and real adoption by the officials and citizens who depend on them.

I describe myself as a T-shaped specialist. The deep discipline is DPI governance. The breadth comes from applying it across civil registration and vital statistics, trade and business registries, NGO and civil-society regulation, and disaster management information systems.
Alongside my consulting work I run Synapse Consulting, mentor project managers through PMI Bangladesh, and research how to measure the governance maturity of foundational DPI.
cvProfile: Digitalisation and systems architecture specialist with 18+ years delivering e-governance and digital public infrastructure (DPI) programmes in Bangladesh for UNDP, USAID and the British Council. T-shaped DPI governance specialist: DPI governance as the core discipline, applied to civil registration and vital statistics (CRVS), trade and business registries, NGO/CSO digitalisation and disaster management information systems. Founder of Synapse Consulting. Available for international remote consulting with UN agencies, international NGOs and donor-funded programmes.

caseStudy.name: NGOAB Online Solution
caseStudy.client: NGO Affairs Bureau, Prime Minister's Office
caseStudy.role: National Consultant – Technical Project Implementation Expert
caseStudy.challenge: Every NGO and foreign-funded project in Bangladesh is registered, approved and monitored by the NGO Affairs Bureau. The work involved paper forms, multiple offices and field-level verification by district and upazila administrations.
caseStudy.solution: A national online platform for NGO registration, project approval and oversight under the Institutional Strengthening for Promoting Accelerated Transformation (ISPAT) Project, with role-based dashboards scoped to each user's role and jurisdiction.
users: NGOAB officials, up to the Director General
Deputy Commissioners and UNOs in the field
